verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a backend-as-a-service, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no self-hostable deployment of Firebase. The documentation describes a managed, Google-run service ("without managing servers", "deploy … to our servers"). The Local Emulator Suite is a local testing and QA tool, not production self-hosting, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The user's own workaround of avoiding proprietary features to keep export easy also earns no credit.
